Session date: 9:39 am on 15 October, 2023
[D23:1] Dave: Hey Cal, miss ya! Crazy rollercoaster week. A competing car maintenance shop snagged a deal we were trying to secure for months and it made me feel kinda bummed out. You know, I put in so much effort at work, but it feels like nothing. Am I wasting my time?

[D19:11] Dave: Thanks, Calvin! It means a lot that you appreciate what I do. I'm glad that I can make people happy and that's what I'm gonna keep doing. Got to go now, I have a lot of work to do! Take care!
[D19:12] Calvin: You're really talented, Dave. Keep making people happy and doing what you love. That's what it's all about. See you soon, have a nice one!
Session date: 8:57 pm on 22 September, 2023
[D20:1] Dave: Hey Calvin, good to catch up again! Had a tough time with my car project. Worked on the engine of the vintage Mustang, thought I'd fixed it, but when I started it up, heard a weird noise. So disappointing after putting so much work in. Take a look at the engine!
[D20:1] Image caption (automatic): a photography of a car engine with a small engine
[D20:2] Calvin: Hey Dave, sorry to hear about the car trouble. That must be disappointing after putting so much work into it. Yeah, fixing cars can be tricky. But hey, check out this pic! It's a sign of my hard work and dedication. Looking at it reminds me how far I've come.
[D20:2] Image caption (automatic): a photography of a red sports car parked in a parking lot
[D20:3] Dave: Wow, thanks Calvin! I love the way the sunlight hits this. It's definitely a great symbol of all your hard work. I bet you feel really proud when you look at it. Any special memories with it?
[D20:4] Calvin: Yeah, Dave, I had an amazing drive one summer day. The wind blowing through my hair and the rush of freedom - it was unforgettable. I've pondered the intricacies of life, taking a moment to truly appreciate the path I've chosen and the decisions that have shaped my journey. Also, my trip to Japan was incredible - the culture, the people, everything was so cool. I'm already longing to go back, it was an experience that made all the hard work worth it.
[D20:5] Dave: Wow, Calvin, that's awesome! That feeling of freedom in the summer is the best. A moment of reflection not only makes the journey interesting but also productive! Hey, any songs from your childhood that bring back memories?
[D20:6] Calvin: Yeah, there's this one song that always makes me smile. It played during a road trip with my dad and we had so much fun singing along to it.
[D20:7] Dave: Sounds awesome, Calvin! Road trips with family are always a treat. What's the name of the song?
[D20:8] Calvin: We used to rock a song by Tupac and Dr. Dre called "California Love". Ah, those were the days!
[D20:9] Dave: Sounds great, Cal! "California Love" is a classic! Let me know if you wanna jam some music together!
[D20:10] Calvin: Yeah, let's do it! That would be awesome.

[D28:22] Dave: Thanks Calvin! It took some work, but I'm happy with the result. Take a look at the logo we created for our rock band!
[D28:22] Image caption (automatic): a photography of a guitar logo with the company band logo

[D28:25] Calvin: Wow Dave! Music really has a way of touching our souls.
[D28:26] Dave: Yeah, Calvin! It's amazing how music can really move us. It's almost like a language for our souls.
[D28:27] Calvin: Yup, it's that connection I'm aiming for with my music. Take a loot at my studio setup, that's look awesome, isn't it?
[D28:27] Image caption (automatic): a photography of a recording studio with a monitor, keyboard, and monitor
[D28:28] Dave: Wow, your studio looks stunning! How do you like hanging out here? Do you watch much TV?
[D28:29] Calvin: I only work in the studio. I have another room for relaxation with a TV, just take a look that room is cozy and relaxing. And yeah, It's a great way to unwind and get inspired.
[D28:29] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a living room with a couch, chair, television and a table
[D28:30] Dave: Wow, nice setup! What do you usually watch on it?
[D28:31] Calvin: Thanks, Dave! I usually watch music videos, concerts, and documentaries about artists and their creative process. It's cool to learn more about the industry and see what others do. Plus, it's a source of inspiration for me.
[D28:32] Dave: Wow, Calvin, that's awesome! Keep up the great work! Take a look at the photo!
[D28:32] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a notebook with a pen and a notepad on it
[D28:33] Calvin: Thanks, Dave! Appreciate the support! Does this notebook help you stay connected to the creative process?

[D28:34] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a pink floyd headphone sitting on a shelf
[D28:35] Calvin: Cool, Dave! These really help you stay focused when making music.
[D28:36] Dave: Cool, Calvin! Music really helps me focus and be productive. When I'm doing my car stuff, I listen to vinyl to relax and stay on track.
[D28:37] Calvin: Rockin' it, Dave! Music can definitely affect our mood and help us stay on track. Keep it up!
[D28:38] Dave: Thanks, Calvin! Music really helps with car work. Keeps me focused and makes it feel great. Even though this player is a bit old, he still gets the job done. Check out its photo!


[D28:38] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a record player sitting on the floor next to a couch
[D28:39] Calvin: Cool, Dave! What tunes are you listening to these days?
[D28:40] Dave: Lately, I've been getting into classic rock. The music from that era is timeless.
[D28:41] Calvin: Cool, Dave! Classic rock has had a huge effect on music. Keep discovering!
[D28:42] Dave: Thanks, Calvin! Classic rock has had a huge impact on music. Always fun to dig in and find new tunes. Gotta go back to work, see you soon! Take care!
[D28:43] Calvin: Yeah, Dave! Exploring different styles and times can open up new perspectives. Broadening your musical knowledge is awesome. Good luck with work, see ya!

Session date: 9:15 pm on 13 November, 2023
[D29:1] Calvin: Hey Dave, I invited my old high school buddy to see me perform in Boston! It was insane. It got me thinking about how far I've come and reminded me how important relationships are in this biz. Felt so good!
[D29:2] Dave: Whoa, that's great Calvin! Seeing your old friend must have brought back so many memories. It's awesome to have someone who's been there since the start to support us.
[D29:3] Calvin: Remembering those days made me so nostalgic! Freestyling and talking about getting famous, it's crazy how life has changed. But being around certain people still sparks those same feelings. Take a look at how we freestyled when we were teenagers!
[D29:3] Image caption (automatic): a photography of two men standing on a sidewalk with a car in the background
[D29:4] Dave: Wow, that's a great pic! Did that person make a big difference during your trip?
[D29:5] Calvin: He's been such a great friend to me. Always there to support and encourage me. His positivity has made a big difference in my journey.
[D29:6] Dave: It's great how someone's support and encouragement can really shape our lives! They give us the motivation to keep going and trust ourselves. Do you also find having supportive people around you important for your artist development?
[D29:7] Calvin: Having supportive people is key for me to grow as an artist. They motivate me to get better and stay true to myself. Having support is vital, especially in this tough music industry. Take a look at this photo!
[D29:7] Image caption (automatic): a photography of a group of people sitting around a desk
[D29:8] Dave: Wow, Calvin! Is this a pic of some musicians you're collaborating with?
[D29:9] Calvin: Yeah, I've been supporting some young musicians from a music program. Supporting their passion is amazing and their enthusiasm is inspiring.
[D29:10] Dave: Wow, Calvin, that's amazing! You're really making a difference by supporting the next generation of musicians. It's great to nurture their passion and help them thrive.
[D29:11] Calvin: Thanks, Dave! It's like a torch being passed to keep music alive! These young musicians are very ambitious, I think I will support them for a long time.	
[D29:12] Dave: Yeah, Calvin! Your support for them keeps the music going and passes on the legacy. That's so awesome!
[D29:13] Calvin: I'm stoked I made a difference. Paying it forward, ya know? Working with new talent brings new ideas to this. Look at this photo, here's how I'm making a beat for a young artist, he has great potential in music! 
[D29:13] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a man sitting at a desk in front of a computer
[D29:14] Dave: Wow, that's cool! Your music studio looks great. Have you tried out any new ideas lately?
[D29:15] Calvin: Thanks! I'm having fun trying out new sounds and pushing the boundaries. It's great to go for new ideas and see where it takes me - always gotta stay ahead in this.
[D29:16] Dave: Awesome, Calvin! Experimenting and pushing boundaries is key to making our art grow. Can't wait to see where these new ideas take you!
[D29:17] Calvin: Yeah, it's exciting to see where these new ideas lead. It's all about growing and evolving! Have a good one. I need to go now. Take care, Dave!
[D29:18] Dave: For sure, Calvin! Growing and evolving is key for any artist. Don't stop pushing yourself and keep exploring. Can't wait to see what you come up with next! See ya Cal! Take care!
